title: Upstream Reasoning Contract Adoption
scope: packages/core/src/types/upstream plus the scanner-to-upstream capability adapter only

results.name: canonical relation identity ADT exists
results.detail: The existing upstream identity type and key function are the canonical identity authority.

results.name: relation evidence is converted to canonical identity
results.detail: Eloquent evidence is normalized into the same typed identity shape as semantic relations.

results.name: relation alignment uses canonical identity key
results.detail: Alignment compares canonical identity rather than repeating field-by-field matching logic.

results.name: duplicated relation field matching removed
results.detail: The weaker independent identity classifier no longer checks a partial field subset.

results.name: foreign-key identity participates in alignment
results.detail: Relations with the same names but different foreign-key identity do not silently align.

results.name: alignment test retains order-independent mapping
results.detail: Semantic relations remain aligned by identity when their array order differs.

results.name: foreign-key mismatch regression test exists
results.detail: A relation with a mismatched canonical foreign-key identity is rejected.

results.name: route action ADT remains the capability evidence
results.detail: The evidence contract no longer accepts a weaker boolean duplicate beside RouteActionKind.

results.name: mutability derives from canonical action registry
results.detail: Hook, payload, and default error behavior derive from the action ADT registry.

results.name: no raw mutability input is consumed
results.detail: The upstream authority cannot receive a contradictory mutability boolean from its adapter.

results.name: derived mutability is reused consistently
results.detail: The single derived value is reused instead of recomputed at separate call sites.

results.name: canonical reconciliation authority remains upstream
results.detail: Relation applicability and schema reconciliation remain owned by their canonical upstream authority/algebra.

results.name: route-domain judgment remains proof-carrying
results.detail: Domain inference remains an explicit upstream judgment with candidate provenance, not downstream fallback.

results.name: audit is registered
results.detail: The upstream-only audit is reproducible through npm run.

decisions.decision: Adopt ModelSemanticRelationIdentity and modelSemanticRelationIdentityKey; remove partial field-by-field matching.
decisions.reason: The canonical identity already includes the foreign-key key and is shared with graph provenance.

decisions.decision: Use RouteActionKind plus ROUTE_ACTION_KIND_REGISTRY instead of accepting isMutating as a second input fact.
decisions.reason: A boolean duplicate can contradict the stronger action ADT; derive it once and reuse it.
This is the canonical authority producing ranked candidates and provenance, not duplicate downstream classification.

decisions.decision: Keep applicability inside SemanticReconciliationEvidence and the canonical algebra.
decisions.reason: The judgment is computed once and passed to candidate/status/schema-evidence consumers.
